title: Owner: repo-specific rules can't be built into the editor

sections.name: words
sections.content: "we can't build our repo specific rules into the editor"

sections.name: context
sections.content: 2026-11-12. Reply to the suggestion that the marker-attribution check be explained to agents editing muDemocracy in srs-web. The editor stays generic: a repository's rules have to travel as that repository's data (package guidance, validation rules) or stay in its CI.
